title: The oscillator
body: Inside the antenna housing, a crystal vibrates at the frequency of the outside room. It is almost warm.

outcome.text: The smog becomes a flat grey wall. In your thermos, the coffee is briefly cold. You have the signal.

choices.label: Hold the housing open and listen.

outcome.text: The outside room says: We can hear you. You take the CRYSTAL before the roof can close.
